later upstream feature-system changes are not adopted (see
dc_phoible_source.rst upgrade policy).

Version policy: docs/source/data_contracts/dc_phoible_source.rst

Distribution: vendored in-repo for developer and test use; included
in source distributions via MANIFEST.in, excluded from end-user
packages. Decided 2026-10-04.
